title: The Forgotten Oath
logline: A veteran uncovers a long-buried military charter proving that their squad's descendants rightfully own the sector's main trade hub.

roles.description: Old, tired, but fiercely loyal to their fallen comrades.
Wealthy, elitist, terrified of losing their cushy position.
A bustling, incredibly wealthy commercial station.
High-end corporate security hired to quietly fix problems.
The marginalized descendants of the original founders.

public_situation: The {role:hub_manager} is preparing to celebrate the station's decennial founding by a corporate conglomerate.
private_truth: The station was actually built by a regiment of war veterans who were unlawfully evicted, and the charter proving it is hidden in the foundation.

beats.public_change: The veteran publicly claims ownership of the hub and is mocked by local media.

missions.reason: The veteran hires the pilot to run a deep-penetrating scan on the hub's oldest structural pillar.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals a hidden vault containing the original founding charter.

beats.public_change: Corporate security breaks into the vault and steals the charter before the veteran can claim it.

missions.reason: The veteran needs the pilot to intercept the mercenary ship carrying the charter and blow it out of their hold.
missions.private_fact: The mercenaries have orders to destroy the document if cornered.

beats.public_change: The pilot holds the charter, and the manager panics.

missions.reason: The veteran asks the pilot to destroy the final mercenary guard ship blockading the broadcast array so they can publish the charter.
missions.private_fact: The mercenary captain hails the pilot mid-fight, relaying the hub manager's offer: a permanent luxury suite and a massive payout to burn the charter instead.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the blockade and broadcasts the charter.
resolutions.summary: The sector courts uphold the charter. The hub manager is evicted, and the station's profits are redirected to the impoverished descendants of the veterans.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved the biggest trade hub in the sector was stolen from war heroes, and gave it back.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the manager's offer.
resolutions.summary: The charter burns. The anniversary celebration goes off without a hitch, while the veteran dies penniless and bitter.
The mercenaries successfully destroy the charter. The truth is lost to history.

loose_threads.detail: The mercenary guards weren't paid by the hub manager; their contracts trace back to an off-world terraforming consortium.
The structural pillar hiding the vault was deliberately shielded against deep-scans using tech that didn't exist a decade ago.

radio_hooks: Local eccentric {role:grizzled_veteran} arrested for trespassing on station property.

voice_direction.grizzled_veteran: Deep, rumbling, speaks with absolute, unshakeable certainty.
